hero.title: Connect with Your Community
hero.subtitle: Go Touch Grass bridges volunteers and local needs across small-town Japan.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Residents, businesses, and organisations post volunteer opportunities with location, time, and skills needed.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Volunteers browse nearby opportunities, filter by skill and schedule, and apply with a message.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Our AI agent reviews applicants, scores matches, and helps requesters confirm the best fit.

opportunities.title: Volunteer Opportunities
opportunities.intro: Browse nearby volunteer tasks. This side is for volunteers who want to find something to join.

new.title: Post an Opportunity
new.intro: Create a request for volunteers. This side is for employers, organizers, and local groups.

placeholders.title: e.g. Help clean the community garden
placeholders.description: Describe the work, schedule, location, and what volunteers should know.

application.title: Apply to Volunteer
application.messagePlaceholder: Tell the requester why you're a great fit…

auth.signInTitle: Sign in to Go Touch Grass
auth.volunteerSignInIntro: Use this entrance to find opportunities and apply as a volunteer.
auth.requesterSignInIntro: Use this entrance to post needs and manage volunteer opportunities.
auth.volunteerRegisterNote: You are creating a volunteer account for browsing and applying to opportunities.
auth.requesterRegisterNote: You are creating an employer account for posting volunteer opportunities.
auth.noAccount: Sign in or create an account to continue.

profile.volunteerSetupIntro: Tell the platform what you are interested in, where you are, and when you can usually help.
profile.requesterSetupIntro: Tell volunteers who is posting the opportunity and what kind of environment they can expect.
profile.volunteerEditIntro: Update your volunteer details so future recommendations and applications fit you better.
profile.requesterEditIntro: Update your organizer profile so volunteers understand your group and location.
profile.becomeRequesterBody: Your current account is set up for volunteering. To post a need, add an employer profile to this same account. Your volunteer profile will stay available.
profile.becomeVolunteerBody: Your current account is set up for posting needs. To apply for opportunities, add a volunteer profile to this same account. Your employer profile will stay available.
